comment: Menu item names in the installed 2.0.3 are 'Output file', 'Select...', 'Append -001, -002, etc.', 'Audio formats', 'Video formats', 'Encoder settings', 'Sample rate' and 'Bit depth'. The format ids run wav, aiff, flac, alac, mp3, opus, mpeg2, ffv1, huffyuv, with display names beside them; h264 is one of them: the id and the display name 'H.264' sit inside the same table as 'MPEG-2 video', 'HuffYUV (lossless)' and 'FFV1 (lossless)', each id immediately before its name, so it is offered like the rest. That the file and the format can only be changed while stopped comes from VCV's manual.
